functions.name: RaySphereQuadraticIntersectionTest
functions.summary: Ray-sphere quadratic intersection test on six double inputs (a1..a6). Builds squared-offset and difference terms, resolves a degenerate axis by swapping terms, then solves the quadratic and returns 1/sqrt(p) as a penetration-length proxy, or 0.0 on any miss. Called by VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation (00401340).

operations.description: Squared-offset terms: v19 = a1*a1 + a2*a2 and v18 = v19 - a3*a3 - a4*a4
Difference terms from doubled coordinates: v21 = a1+a1, v17 = a3+a3-v21, v20 = a2+a2, v6 = a4+a4-v20, then v23 = v19 - a5*a5 - a6*a6, v22 = a5+a5-v21, v7 = a6+a6-v20
Degenerate axis handling: if v6==0.0 and v7==0.0, return 0.0 (no intersection); otherwise when v6==0.0 swap the two axis term groups so the quadratic can be solved
Quadratic coefficient: v12 = -(v7 / v6), then v13 = v17 * v12 + v22; return 0.0 when v13 == 0.0
Root computation: v14 = (v12 * v18 + v23) * (-1.0 / v13); return 0.0 when v24 == 0.0
Final offset term: v15 = (v22 * v14 + v23) * (-1.0 / v24) - a4
Magnitude: v16 = sqrt(v15*v15 + (v14 - a3)*(v14 - a3))
Return 0.0 when v16 == 0.0 (miss), otherwise return 1.0 / v16 as the penetration-length proxy
Invoked by VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation (00401340) to evaluate the ray-sphere penetration along the suspension travel axis

When a3 is null, initializes best candidates to huge sentinel values and scans the strut array (base this+0x134, stride 316, count this+0x130), keeping the closest strut and the closest candidate that passes the plane test. Returns the closest qualifying node pointer, or the plane-verified candidate if the final signed-distance check is non-negative.
